SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme Explained: $4,000 Credit and Training Allowance

Quick Answer

  • The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme gives Singapore Citizens aged 40 to 60 a S$4,000 SkillsFuture Credit top-up that does not expire.
  • This top-up can only be used for full-length diploma or professional certification courses, not short workshops or individual modules.
  • Combined with the Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy (up to 90% course fee subsidy), the S$4,000 top-up can cover the entire cost of a diploma at polytechnics, ITE, or approved private training providers.
  • Eligible full-time learners can receive a training allowance of up to S$3,000/month, based on 50% of their average income over the latest 12 months.
  • From early 2026, the allowance extends to part-time training at a flat rate of S$300/month.
  • The allowance supports both full-time and part-time long-form training for a total of 24 months over an individual's lifetime.

Introduction

Mid-career Singaporeans facing industry disruption or wanting a genuine skills reset often assume SkillsFuture only covers short courses — and miss out on the far more powerful Level-Up Programme, which is specifically designed to fund a substantive career pivot through a full diploma or certification. Because the Level-Up Programme overlaps with several other schemes (base SkillsFuture Credit, Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy, Mid-Career Training Allowance), many eligible residents either underuse their benefits or wrongly assume they need to fund training entirely out of pocket. This guide walks through exactly how the pieces fit together and what a real career switch could look like financially.

What Is the SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme?

The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme is a national initiative providing greater support for mid-career Singaporeans aged 40 and above to pursue a substantive skills reboot and remain relevant amid economic change. It bundles together three main forms of support:

  1. SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top-up of S$4,000, which does not expire, to offset course fees.
  2. SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance for eligible full-time (and now part-time) long-form programmes.
  3. Greater access to full-time diplomas at polytechnics, ITE, and Arts Institutions via direct admission pathways.

Who Is Eligible

  • Singapore Citizens aged 40 to 60 at the time the top-up was announced.
  • The S$4,000 top-up applies specifically to full-length courses: diploma programmes at polytechnics or ITE, professional certification programmes, selected Specialist Diploma and Post-Diploma courses, and full WSQ qualifications — not individual WSQ modules or short workshops.

How the Credit and Subsidies Stack

Support Layer What It Covers Typical Value
Base SkillsFuture Credit General course fee offset Varies by individual balance
SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) Level-Up top-up Full diplomas/certifications only S$4,000, non-expiring
Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy Course fee subsidy for SC aged 40+ Up to 90% of course fee
SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance (full-time) Income replacement while studying 50% of average 12-month income, capped at S$3,000/month
SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance (part-time, from early 2026) Defray incidental training expenses Flat S$300/month

When the Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy (up to 90% course fee subsidy) is combined with existing SkillsFuture Credit and the S$4,000 Level-Up top-up, it is possible for the entire cost of a diploma programme to be covered.

Step-by-Step: How to Use the Level-Up Programme

  1. Log in to MySkillsFuture using Singpass and check your existing SkillsFuture Credit balance.
  2. Confirm the S$4,000 Level-Up top-up is reflected in your account (automatically credited if eligible).
  3. Browse qualifying diploma and certification programmes, filtering for those marked as "Level Up eligible" on MySkillsFuture.
  4. Speak with an education counsellor at your chosen institution to confirm course structure and funding stack.
  5. Enrol in the programme — the Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy and your SkillsFuture Credits (including the Level-Up top-up) are applied at the payment stage.
  6. For full-time study, apply for the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance through your institution.
  7. Begin your programme and receive monthly training allowance disbursements, if applicable, throughout your course.

Worked Example: Mid-Career Professional Switching Fields

Profile: A 45-year-old Singapore Citizen earning an average of S$5,000/month over the past 12 months, wanting to pursue a full-time diploma in a new technical field.

  • Course fee coverage: The Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy covers up to 90% of the course fee; the remaining 10% can typically be offset using the S$4,000 Level-Up Credit top-up plus any existing base SkillsFuture Credit, potentially reducing out-of-pocket cost to near zero.
  • Training allowance: At 50% of the S$5,000 average monthly income, this professional could receive up to S$2,500/month in training allowance while studying full-time (below the S$3,000 monthly cap).
  • Total support window: This allowance is available for eligible full-time study, drawing from a lifetime total of 24 months of allowance support (full-time and part-time combined).

Full-Time vs Part-Time Training Support

Factor Full-Time Training Part-Time Training (from early 2026)
Course fee subsidy Up to 90% via Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy Same subsidy structure, if course qualifies
Credit top-up S$4,000 Level-Up top-up applies to eligible full diplomas S$4,000 Level-Up top-up applies to eligible full diplomas
Income support Up to S$3,000/month (50% of average 12-month income) Flat S$300/month to defray incidental expenses
Best for Residents able to pause employment for a full career reset Residents continuing to work while upskilling
Lifetime cap Shares a combined 24-month lifetime cap with part-time support Shares a combined 24-month lifetime cap with full-time support

Common Mistakes Residents Make

  • Assuming the S$4,000 top-up covers any course: It applies only to full-length diploma or certification programmes — not short skills workshops or single modules.
  • Not checking "Level Up eligible" filter on MySkillsFuture: Some courses that qualify for base SkillsFuture Credit do not qualify for the Level-Up top-up specifically.
  • Missing the training allowance application window: The training allowance must be applied for through the institution — it is not automatically disbursed just by enrolling.
  • Underestimating how the 24-month lifetime cap works: Because full-time and part-time allowance support share the same lifetime cap, residents who use it early for a short stint may have less available for a later, longer programme.
  • Not confirming eligibility age cut-off: Eligibility is anchored to age 40–60 at the time the top-up was announced, which residents should verify rather than assume based on their current age.

Frequently Asked Questions

Am I eligible for the SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme? You need to be a Singapore Citizen aged 40 to 60 at the time the top-up was announced; check your MySkillsFuture account to confirm whether the S$4,000 top-up has been credited.

Does the $4,000 Level-Up Credit expire? No, the SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) Level-Up top-up does not expire, unlike some other time-limited credit schemes.

Can I use the Level-Up top-up for a short course? No. It is specifically for full-length diploma and professional certification programmes, not short workshops or standalone modules.

How much training allowance will I get if I study full-time? You can receive up to 50% of your average income over the latest available 12-month period, capped at a maximum of S$3,000 per month.

What changed for part-time learners in 2026? From early 2026, the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance extends to selected part-time training, offering a flat S$300/month to help cover incidental training expenses while learners continue working.

Is there a limit on how long I can receive the training allowance? Yes, the allowance supports both full-time and part-time long-form training for a combined total of 24 months over an individual's lifetime.

Can I combine the Level-Up top-up with the Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy? Yes, combining both can significantly reduce or even eliminate your out-of-pocket course fees for an eligible full diploma or certification programme.

Key Takeaways

  • The SkillsFuture Level-Up Programme targets Singaporeans aged 40–60 with a non-expiring S$4,000 credit for full diplomas and certifications.
  • Stacking the Level-Up top-up with the Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy can cover close to 100% of course fees for eligible programmes.
  • Full-time learners can receive up to S$3,000/month in training allowance; part-time learners get S$300/month from early 2026.
  • All allowance support shares a combined 24-month lifetime cap, so plan your usage strategically.
